args.summary:
Built a 2D spine-beam OpenSeesPy model of the 10×25 m precast small-box girder unit (simple during erection, continuous in service; structure.system = continuous since no pier column geometry was given).

Key modelling decisions (all KG-validated):
- Idealization: spine_beam_2d, linear elastic (MR-01); system continuous (MR-05).
- Girder section (small_box, integrated): A_single = 1.0605 m², I_single = 0.25166 m⁴; ×4 girders → A = 4.2421 m², I = 1.00663 m⁴ (MR-02). Ec = 34 500 MPa (JTG 3362-2018 3.1.5, C50); γ = 26.0 kN/m³ (JTG D60-2015 4.2.1); w = 110.29 kN/m, m = 11.243 t/m (MR-07).
- Bearings: 8 per support line (2 per girder end × 4 girders, MR-04). Abutments 0/10 and Piers 1–4, 7–9: PTFE sliding laminated elastomeric (300×350 mm, 4×8 mm layers): S = 10.096, Kv = 1.133×10⁷ kN/m, Kh = 0 (longitudinally free, MR-03). Piers 5 and 6: plain laminated elastomeric (fixed): Kh = 26 250 kN/m, same Kv; vertical spring, rotation free.
- Live load (JTG D60-2015 Class I): 3 design lanes (11.5 m carriageway, one-way), ξ = 0.78, qk = 10.5 kN/m, Pk = 310 kN per span (L0 = 25 m).
- Impact factor: modal analysis gave f1 = 4.415 Hz → μ = 0.1767·ln(f1) − 0.0157 = 0.2467 (JTG D60-2015 4.3.2).

Check results: L1/L2/L3 all passed. First three vertical bending frequencies 4.415 / 4.536 / 4.884 Hz. Self-weight reactions ~1088 kN at abutments, 2660–3125 kN at interior piers; self-weight midspan moments up to 4985 kN·m; live-load max +M = 6410 kN·m, max −M = −4601 kN·m (both at the end spans/abutment-adjacent regions).
